title: “Seeing” (Sub) Nanoscale Moiré Excitons with meV Scale Energy Resolution
content: Twist degree of freedom is the novel way to confine excitons in zero-and one-dimensions by the interplay of flat bands, strong moiré potential, and kinetic energy in transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) [1]. The moiré potential, which directly impacts the confinement of excitons, modulates based on the local pico-to nanoscale lattice fluctuations [2] .Hence, it is important to develop metrologies that can concurrently image lattice fluctuations and locate the real-space exciton distribution to demystify the exciton confinement process.
